summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) using wave-based parallel execution, capturing meaningful load test baselines against staging including BYO-IPFS (Pinata) capacity testing.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed: shared account cleanup helper wired into 10 specs, media/streaming and batch download E2E suites added (16+ new tests), and staging baselines captured (journey timing, 200-client SDK sustained load). BYO Pinata pin confirmed working (p50=718ms) but CID registration returns 400s — tracked as a todo.

repo: Staging Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s — wallet-login-button timeout in journey-timing.spec.ts needed to be raised from 20s to 45s for staging runs
BASE_URL env var was not overriding Playwright's baseURL config — playwright.config.ts needed explicit `process.env.BASE_URL` check and conditional webServer block
SDK load tests use destroyClientPool() → deleteTestAccount() (direct API, headless); browser load test used deleteAccountViaPage() (browser fetch with cookies) — distinct paths
Running two load test suites simultaneously against the same staging instance causes 429s even with bypass header — throttle bypass works fine when tests run in isolation
Pinata free tier has storage/pin quota limits that can be exhausted by load testing — a paid plan or fresh account is required for BYO capacity ceiling tests
BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging when using Pinata provider — Pinata pin succeeds but CipherBox API rejects CID registration (likely test account not in BYO mode)
Vitest does not automatically load .env files — requires explicit shell env sourcing before running tests (e.g. `set -a && source .env && set +a`)
cleanup-helpers.ts was making two separate page.evaluate() browser round-trips for token refresh — merged into one call
Browser load test (load-test.spec.ts) measured Playwright/Chromium overhead rather than API performance — removed in favour of SDK-based harness

code.finding: waitFor timeout of 20s is too short for staging Web3Auth init (~22.7s) — needs 45s+ for staging runs
Added BASE_URL env var override for staging and conditional webServer block (skip local dev server when targeting staging)
API URL derivation must use page URL to construct API URL for staging (not hardcoded localhost:3000); also merged double page.evaluate into one round-trip
Vitest does not load .env automatically — env vars must be sourced in shell before running tests
Dynamic fs/path imports moved to top-level; existsSync+unlinkSync TOCTOU replaced with try/catch; corrupt file test wrapped in try/finally for guaranteed cleanup
Removed 40-line inline deleteAccount() and replaced with shared deleteAccountViaPage() helper from cleanup-helpers.ts
200-client baseline: 11,174 total ops, 0.17% error rate, uploadFile p50=8.1s p95=11.6s, createFolder p50=6.5s — meaningful staging capacity data

workflow: When running multiple load test suites against the same staging API, run them sequentially not in parallel to avoid artificial throttle saturation
Cherry-picking commits from worktree branches to a phase branch requires careful STATE.md conflict resolution (take worktree version, restore stashed local changes after)
GSD classifyHandoffIfNeeded false failure pattern: agent reports failed but SUMMARY.md exists and commits are present — treat as successful
GSD worktrees should be cleaned up immediately after cherry-picking to avoid stale git locks that block subsequent agent spawns
Verifying staging env vars by curling the health endpoint and testing bypass header directly with curl is faster than SSH into the Docker container

friction: Cherry-picking between worktree branches and phase branch caused repeated STATE.md merge conflicts requiring manual resolution
Stale worktree from 34-03 git lock required force removal before retry
Vitest does not load .env files — required discovering this via failed tests and adding shell env sourcing workaround
Running two load tests simultaneously caused spurious 429s that were initially misdiagnosed as a bypass header bug, requiring extensive investigation
SSH access to staging Docker container failed (timeout/key issue), blocking direct env var verification
Pinata free tier quota was exhausted by load testing before meaningful BYO ceiling data could be captured
1Password commit signing failures required retrying commits with direct git commands
Phase was prematurely marked complete in ROADMAP/STATE before meaningful load test baselines existed — required rollback and re-planning
open_items: BYO-IPFS register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging — tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-debug-byo-ipfs-register-cid-400-errors-on-staging.md
BYO Pinata capacity ceiling test needs a paid Pinata plan or clean account with quota headroom to capture meaningful pin-throughput baselines
New E2E specs (media-preview, streaming-playback, batch-download) use binary stub fixtures that need a live environment run to confirm AES-CTR/GCM code paths are exercised correctly
throttle bypass header forwarding during createTestAccount should be explicitly tested in CI to prevent future confusion when staging and CI behave differently
Playwright config BASE_URL override and webServer conditional should be documented in tests/web-e2e/README or CLAUDE.md for future staging test runs
